nodes.description: Private constant threshold of 4 votes required before liquidation executes.
Private constant percentage (20) of the contract's ETHPoly balance to liquidate.
Address payable that receives the contract balance in process(); a transfer target.
Array of addresses eligible to vote; iterated by totalVotes and _resetVotes.
Mapping tracking whether an address has voted.
Address authorised to configure the ETHPoly contract; used as access control anchor.
External ETHPoly interface used for balanceOf, dividendsOf, liquidate and withdraw.
Constructor: records msg.sender as deployer and seeds the targets array.
Payable receive fallback that accepts plain ETH.
External setter for ethPoly guarded only by require(msg.sender == deployer).
Withdraws ETHPoly dividends and forwards the whole contract balance to splitter.
Records a vote, and on reaching MIN_VOTES calls liquidate, process and _resetVotes.
External function revoking the caller's vote.
View function counting votes among the registered targets.
View function returning whether an address has voted.
Internal function clearing the votes of all targets.
Caller-controlled address used for vote bookkeeping and access control.
External call to ethPoly.withdraw() inside process(); potential reentrancy vector.
Native ETH transfer of the full contract balance to splitter; potential reentrancy vector.
External call to ethPoly.liquidate() inside vote(); reachable state-changing external call.
Arithmetic expression ethPoly.balanceOf(this) * LIQUIDATION_PERCENT / 100 computed in vote().
Parameter of setETHPoly carrying the new ETHPoly implementation address.
Local variable in process() holding address(this).balance before the transfer.
Parameter of voted() used to index the votes mapping.
Local counter in totalVotes() accumulating the number of votes.
Loop index used by totalVotes() and _resetVotes() to iterate targets.

edges.reason: constructor reads msg.sender to initialise the deployer address.
constructor writes msg.sender into the deployer state variable.
setETHPoly assigns its argument into the ethPoly state variable.
The _ethPoly parameter flows into the ethPoly state variable.
setETHPoly is gated only by require(msg.sender == deployer).
setETHPoly reads deployer to enforce the caller check.
setETHPoly consumes the _ethPoly parameter.
process() performs an external call ethPoly.withdraw() before state changes settle.
process() forwards the entire balance to splitter via transfer, an outbound call-back path.
process() caches address(this).balance into the _balance local variable.
The _balance local is passed as the amount to splitter.transfer.
The splitter state variable is the recipient of the transfer.
The ethPoly state variable is the target of the withdraw external call.
The ethPoly state variable is the target of the liquidate external call.
vote() reads msg.sender to key the votes mapping.
vote() writes votes[msg.sender] = true.
vote() calls totalVotes() to decide whether the threshold is reached.
vote() uses LIQUIDATION_PERCENT inside the liquidation amount calculation.
vote() triggers the external ethPoly.liquidate() call.
vote() evaluates balanceOf(this) * LIQUIDATION_PERCENT / 100 before liquidating.
vote() calls process(), which performs further external calls and value transfer.
vote() calls _resetVotes() after a successful liquidation.
unvote() reads msg.sender to identify the caller's vote.
unvote() sets votes[msg.sender] = false.
totalVotes() iterates over the targets array.
totalVotes() delegates each membership check to voted().
totalVotes() indirectly reads the votes mapping through voted().
totalVotes() increments the _count local accumulator.
totalVotes() uses the loop index i to traverse targets.
voted() reads the votes mapping for the supplied address.
voted() uses the _user parameter as the mapping key.
_resetVotes() iterates over the targets array.
_resetVotes() writes false into the votes mapping for each target.
_resetVotes() uses the loop index i to traverse targets.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _ethPoly only carries data into the setETHPoly function body; collapse it into that core function.
Local _balance is a temporary snapshot inside process() feeding the transfer; merge into process.
Parameter _user is only used to index votes inside voted(); merge into the voted function.
Local _count is a purely internal accumulator of totalVotes(); merge into that function.
Loop index i is a transient iterator used by totalVotes()/_resetVotes(); merge into the totalVotes core function.
